description.text: Introduction This project is undertaken by School of Mechatronics Engineering of WUT. And the school has majors of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Monitoring Technology and Equipment, Process Equipment and Control Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Packaging Engineering, Institute of Tribology, Digital Manufacture Center and R&D Center of Building Materials. The teachers are mainly professors who graduate from distinguished universities in Europe and USA, and they are all experienced in teaching and supervising international students. Directions of Cultivation Advanced engineering and technical personnel who can make quantitative analysis and optimization designing in terms of systems on problems of actual engineering and management in technical management, production planning, operations management and many other aspects.Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Internship Practice,coursedesign,surveyingandmappingpractice,graduationpractice,graduationdesign. Duration 4 years DegreeAwarded BachelorDegreeofEngineering.

duration.text: The Industrial Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
